description: This file is a Perl module that provides functions and variables for parsing and managing package and target metadata in a build system, likely related to OpenWrt. It exports functions for reading package specifications, target configurations, and package manifests, and maintains internal data structures for these entities.

methods.name: get_multiline
methods.description: Reads multiple lines from a file handle until a line starting with '@@' is encountered, concatenating lines with optional prefixes.

methods.name: confstr
methods.description: Sanitizes a configuration string by replacing certain characters with underscores.

methods.name: parse_package_metadata_usergroup
methods.description: Parses user or group specifications from package metadata, updating internal hashes while validating IDs and names.

methods.name: parse_target_metadata
methods.description: Reads and parses target configuration files, extracting target parameters, profiles, dependencies, and subtargets.

methods.name: clear_packages
methods.description: Resets internal data structures related to packages, versions, categories, user/group info.

methods.name: parse_package_metadata
methods.description: Reads and parses package metadata files, populating internal data structures for packages, sources, and overrides.

methods.name: parse_package_manifest_metadata
methods.description: Reads and parses package manifest metadata, extracting package details and dependencies.
